subject.title: feat: expose UI diagnostics on the debug page

question: May the authenticated Debug page ship this exact UI diagnostics allowlist, including locale, exact viewport/screen dimensions, DPR, theme, browser capability booleans, and media-device counts?
rationale: The patch is narrow and privacy-aware, but choosing which browser/display/media facts are support-safe is a maintainer security/product boundary rather than a purely mechanical code-review call.

options.title: Approve Narrow Allowlist After Proof
options.body: Accept this authenticated-only allowlist once the PR adds redacted live Debug-page proof and is refreshed against current main.

options.title: Narrow The Fact List
options.body: Ask the branch to bucket or remove higher-fingerprint facts such as exact screen size, locale, or media counts before another review.

options.title: Defer To Broader Diagnostics Design
options.body: Keep the candidate paused until the broader diagnostics/security design settles shared redaction and export rules.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Allowlist After Proof
recommendation.body: Accept this authenticated-only allowlist once the PR adds redacted live Debug-page proof and is refreshed against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current proposal and has the strongest recent history on the Debug page and related product/security boundary.
